instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: עתיד: will + פועל.
אחרי will אין to.

explanation.he: Grandma will bake a cake tomorrow. עתיד: will + פועל בצורת בסיס, בלי to.

items.answer: There were many people at the Kotel.
alternatives: At the Kotel there were many people.
items.audioText: There were many people at the Kotel.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: "היו" במובן "נמצאו" = There were / There was.
people זה רבים.

explanation.he: There were many people at the Kotel. people זו מילה ברבים, ולכן There were. ביחיד: There was.

items.prompt: תמר לא הלכה לבית הספר ביום שני.
items.answer: Tamar didn't go to school on Monday.
alternatives: On Monday Tamar didn't go to school.
items.audioText: Tamar didn't go to school on Monday.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: שלילה בעבר: didn't + פועל.
אחרי didn't: צורת בסיס.

explanation.he: Tamar didn't go to school on Monday. שלילה בעבר: didn't + צורת בסיס (go). לפני יום: on.

items.answer: Why are you laughing?
items.audioText: Why are you laughing?

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: שאלה על מה שקורה עכשיו: Why + are + you + ing.
are בא לפני you בשאלה.

explanation.he: Why are you laughing? בשאלה פועל העזר (are) בא לפני הנושא (you). ועל מה שקורה עכשיו: ing.

items.prompt: אנחנו הולכים לבקר את גברת קליין ביום שישי.
items.answer: We are going to visit Mrs. Klein on Friday.
alternatives: On Friday we are going to visit Mrs. Klein.
items.audioText: We are going to visit Mrs. Klein on Friday.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: "הולכים ל..." על תוכנית = are going to.
לפני יום: on.

explanation.he: We are going to visit Mrs. Klein on Friday. going to + פועל מתאר תוכנית לעתיד. לפני יום בשבוע: on.

items.prompt: רבקה כתבה מכתב כשאבא הגיע הביתה.
items.answer: Rivka was writing a letter when Dad came home.
alternatives: When Dad came home Rivka was writing a letter.
items.audioText: Rivka was writing a letter when Dad came home.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: רבקה הייתה באמצע הכתיבה.
hints.en: She was in the middle of writing.

hints.he: was + ing לפעולה הארוכה.

explanation.he: Rivka was writing a letter when Dad came home. הפעולה הארוכה: was writing. הפעולה הקצרה שקטעה אותה: came. בעברית "כתבה" לשתיהן.
explanation.en: Long action: was writing. Short: came.

items.answer: Ari is taller than Moshe.
items.audioText: Ari is taller than Moshe.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: "גבוה מ..." = taller ...
"מ" בהשוואה = than.

explanation.he: Ari is taller than Moshe. בהשוואה: er + than. בעברית "מ", באנגלית than, לא from.

items.prompt: בדרך כלל אנחנו אוכלים דג בשבת.
items.answer: We usually eat fish on Shabbat.
alternatives: Usually we eat fish on Shabbat.
On Shabbat we usually eat fish.
We eat fish on Shabbat usually.
Usually on Shabbat we eat fish.
On Shabbat usually we eat fish.
items.audioText: We usually eat fish on Shabbat.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: usually בא בדרך כלל לפני הפועל.
לפני יום: on.

explanation.he: We usually eat fish on Shabbat. מילות תדירות (usually, always) באות בדרך כלל בין הנושא לפועל. לפני יום: on.

items.answer: Can you help me, please?
alternatives: Please can you help me?
Can you please help me?
items.audioText: Can you help me, please?

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: שאלה עם can: Can + you + פועל.
אחרי can אין to, ואחרי help אין "ל".
hints.en: No to after can. help me.

explanation.he: Can you help me, please? בשאלה can בא לפני you. אחרי can פועל בצורת בסיס בלי to. בעברית "לעזור לי", באנגלית help me.

items.answer: Pesach is in the spring.
items.audioText: Pesach is in the spring.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: פסח = Pesach. בעברית אין פועל.
עונות באות עם in.

explanation.he: Pesach is in the spring. Pesach הוא חג הפסח. באנגלית צריך is. לפני עונה או חודש: in.

items.answer: They gave tzedakah to a poor family.
items.audioText: They gave tzedakah to a poor family.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: צדקה = tzedakah. give הוא פועל חריג.
"משפחה ענייה": התואר לפני שם העצם.

explanation.he: They gave tzedakah to a poor family. tzedakah היא צדקה. give → gave. "משפחה ענייה" = a poor family, התואר קודם.

items.prompt: לחבר של ארי יש אופניים אדומים חדשים.
items.answer: Ari's friend has a new red bike.
items.audioText: Ari's friend has a new red bike.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: "החבר של ארי" = Ari's friend.
קודם גיל (new), אחר כך צבע (red).

explanation.he: Ari's friend has a new red bike. "של ארי" = Ari's. סדר התארים: גיל לפני צבע: a new red bike. עם he: has.

items.prompt: אנחנו גרים כאן כבר עשר שנים.
items.answer: We have lived here for ten years.
alternatives: For ten years we have lived here.
items.audioText: We have lived here for ten years.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: עדיין גרים כאן: have + V3.
משך זמן: for. נקודת התחלה: since.

explanation.he: We have lived here for ten years. מה שהתחיל בעבר ונמשך עד עכשיו: Present Perfect. בעברית הווה. משך זמן: for.

items.answer: Have you ever been to Safed?
items.audioText: Have you ever been to Safed?

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: שאלה על ניסיון בחיים: Have + you + ever + V3.
been to = ביקר ב.

explanation.he: Have you ever been to Safed? Safed היא צפת. על ניסיון בחיים: Have you ever + V3. been to = הייתם ב.
explanation.en: Life experience: Have you ever been to...?

items.answer: If it rains, we will eat inside.
alternatives: We will eat inside if it rains.
items.audioText: If it rains, we will eat inside.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: אחרי if: הווה. בחלק השני: will.
it rains עם s.

explanation.he: If it rains, we will eat inside. תנאי ראשון: if + Present Simple, will + פועל. בעברית "אם ירד" בעתיד, באנגלית אחרי if הווה.

items.prompt: בית הכנסת החדש נבנה בשנה שעברה.
items.answer: The new shul was built last year.
alternatives: Last year the new shul was built.
items.audioText: The new shul was built last year.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: סביל בעבר: was + V3.
build → built.

explanation.he: The new shul was built last year. shul = בית כנסת. סביל: was + V3. build הוא חריג: built.

items.prompt: אילו היו לנו כנפיים, היינו עפים לירושלים.
items.answer: If we had wings, we would fly to Jerusalem.
alternatives: We would fly to Jerusalem if we had wings.
items.audioText: If we had wings, we would fly to Jerusalem.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: מצב דמיוני: if + עבר.
בחלק השני: would + פועל.

explanation.he: If we had wings, we would fly to Jerusalem. תנאי שני: if + Past Simple (had), would + פועל. העבר מראה שזה דמיון.

items.answer: Shabbat candles are lit before sunset.
alternatives: Before sunset Shabbat candles are lit.
items.audioText: Shabbat candles are lit before sunset.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: לא אומרים מי מדליק: סביל.
are + V3. light → lit.

explanation.he: Shabbat candles are lit before sunset. סביל בהווה: are + V3. light הוא חריג: lit.

items.prompt: הילדה שגרה בבית הסמוך היא החברה שלי.
items.answer: The girl who lives next door is my friend.
alternatives: My friend is the girl who lives next door.
items.audioText: The girl who lives next door is my friend.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: "ש" אחרי אדם = who.
next door = בבית הסמוך.

explanation.he: The girl who lives next door is my friend. לאנשים: who. which רק לדברים ולבעלי חיים.

items.prompt: ארי כבר סיים את שיעורי הבית שלו.
items.answer: Ari has already finished his homework.
alternatives: Ari has finished his homework already.
items.audioText: Ari has already finished his homework.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: "כבר" במשפט חיובי = already.
has + already + V3.

explanation.he: Ari has already finished his homework. already בא בין has ל־V3 או בסוף. yet בא בשלילה ובשאלה.
explanation.en: has already + V3. yet in negatives.

items.answer: Tamar enjoys helping Mrs. Klein.
items.audioText: Tamar enjoys helping Mrs. Klein.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: אחרי enjoy בא פועל עם ing.
בעברית "נהנית לעזור", אבל באנגלית לא to help.

explanation.he: Tamar enjoys helping Mrs. Klein. אחרי enjoy תמיד ing: enjoy helping. בעברית שם פועל ("לעזור"), ובאנגלית לא אומרים enjoy to help.

items.prompt: סבא היה הולך לבית הכנסת בכל בוקר.
items.answer: Grandpa used to walk to shul every morning.
alternatives: Every morning Grandpa used to walk to shul.
items.audioText: Grandpa used to walk to shul every morning.

instruction.en: Put the words in order to translate the sentence

hints.he: "היה הולך" = הרגל בעבר.
used to + פועל בצורת בסיס.

explanation.he: Grandpa used to walk to shul every morning. הרגל בעבר: used to + פועל. shul = בית כנסת.
